entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`bookId` TEXT NOT NULL, `contentSha256` TEXT NOT NULL, `extractionVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `generation` TEXT NOT NULL, `state` TEXT NOT NULL, `chunkCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `stringBytes` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`bookId`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`rowid` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `bookId` TEXT NOT NULL, `contentSha256` TEXT NOT NULL, `generation` TEXT NOT NULL, `readingOrderIndex` INTEGER NOT NULL, `chunkIndex` INTEGER NOT NULL, `resourceHref` TEXT NOT NULL, `resourceSha256` TEXT NOT NULL, `chapterTitle` TEXT, `text` TEXT NOT NULL, `searchText` TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`bookId`) REFERENCES `text_index_books`(`bookId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )

indices.name: index_text_index_chunks_bookId_chunkIndex
indices.createSql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_text_index_chunks_bookId_chunkIndex` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`bookId`, `chunkIndex`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`searchText` TEXT NOT NULL, tokenize=unicode61 `remove_diacritics=0`, content=`text_index_chunks`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_text_index_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `text_index_chunks` BEGIN DELETE FROM `text_index_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_text_index_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `text_index_chunks` BEGIN DELETE FROM `text_index_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_text_index_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `text_index_chunks` BEGIN INSERT INTO `text_index_fts`(`docid`, `searchText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`searchText`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_text_index_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `text_index_chunks` BEGIN INSERT INTO `text_index_fts`(`docid`, `searchText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`searchText`); END
